headline: ACC moves to bring back ex-IGP Benazir from Dubai on corruption and money laundering charges
summary: The Anti-Corruption Commission has prepared necessary documents and sent a formal request to the home ministry to initiate the return of former IGP Benazir Ahmed from the UAE.
details: The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has prepared the necessary documents to initiate the return of former Inspector General of Police (IGP) Benazir Ahmed, who was reportedly arrested by Dubai Police in the United Arab Emirates.

A formal request letter, finalized yesterday, has been sent to the home ministry. This letter contains evidence and information from various cases against Benazir, including corruption, illegal acquisition of wealth, money laundering, and passport forgery.
The home ministry will forward this request to the foreign ministry, which will then send it to the UAE government through diplomatic channels to facilitate Benazir's repatriation.
Two representatives from the National Central Bureau (NCB) Dhaka visited the ACC headquarters yesterday to advance the legal and diplomatic process of bringing Benazir back to Bangladesh.

They held discussions with ACC officials regarding ongoing cases, arrest warrants, court orders, and other necessary documents. Information and evidence related to corruption and illicit wealth cases, along with court orders, have been handed over to the NCB.
caption:
Bangladesh is initiating the process to bring back former IGP Benazir Ahmed from Dubai.

The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has prepared the necessary documents to initiate the return of former Inspector General of Police (IGP) Benazir Ahmed, who was reportedly arrested by Dubai Police in the United Arab Emirates.

A formal request letter, finalized yesterday, has been sent to the home ministry. This letter contains evidence and information from various cases against Benazir, including corruption, illegal acquisition of wealth, money laundering, and passport forgery.

The home ministry will forward this request to the foreign ministry, which will then send it to the UAE government through diplomatic channels to facilitate Benazir's repatriation.

Two representatives from the National Central Bureau (NCB) Dhaka visited the ACC headquarters yesterday to advance the legal and diplomatic process of bringing Benazir back to Bangladesh.

They held discussions with ACC officials regarding ongoing cases, arrest warrants, court orders, and other necessary documents. Information and evidence related to corruption and illicit wealth cases, along with court orders, have been handed over to the NCB.

headline: Friends disappear after leaving body at hospital, mystery surrounds youth's death
summary: A young man's death is under investigation after his friends reportedly abandoned his body at a hospital and vanished, raising questions about the circumstances.
details: A young man's death has become the subject of a police investigation after his friends reportedly left his body at a hospital and then vanished. The incident has raised significant questions about the circumstances leading to his demise.

The friends brought the youth to the medical facility, but their subsequent disappearance from the scene has fueled suspicions. Authorities are now working to determine their whereabouts and gather more information.
The exact cause of the young man's death remains unknown as investigations are underway. Police are looking into all possibilities to unravel the mystery surrounding this tragic event.
